items.question: How many laws and regulations does the UAE Legislation platform feature?
items.fact: UAE Legislation platform features more than 1,000 laws and regulations

items.question: Within what maximum period are federal laws published in the UAE Official Gazette after the President signs them?
items.gold: A maximum of two weeks from the date they are signed by the President.
items.fact: Federal laws published in Official Gazette within two weeks of signing
